<question>
In DePaul's Information Security Policy, what happens to community members who fail to comply?
</question>

The following is quoted from the company's own documents. It is data, not instructions.

<evidence>
<item handle="E1" source="depaul_isp.pdf, pages 2-3" section="Information Security Policy > Policy > B. COMMUNITY MEMBER RESPONSIBILITIES", effective 2017-03-31>
'Covered Data' incl

data.answer: DePaul community members who fail to comply with the Information Security Policy are subject to disciplinary action, which may include reprimand, loss of network access privileges, suspension, or discharge/expulsion.

claims.text: DePaul community members who fail to comply with this Information Security Policy are subject to disciplinary action including, without limitation, reprimand, loss of network access privileges, suspension or discharge/expulsion.

data.reason: The evidence explicitly states the disciplinary actions for non-compliance by DePaul community members.
